# Idelyze — Digital Design Studio

Idelyze is a digital design studio based in India, offering UI/UX Design, Web Development, SEO Optimisation, Branding, Social Media Marketing, and Digital Systems.

## Services
- UI/UX Design: Interface design, wireframes, prototypes, Figma handoff
- Web Development: Responsive websites, CMS integration, performance optimisation
- SEO Optimisation: Keyword research, on-page SEO, technical SEO, backlink strategy
- Branding: Logo design, brand identity, visual systems, brand guidelines
- Social Media: Instagram and Facebook content, strategy, reels, analytics
- Digital Systems: End-to-end brand + web + SEO + social packages
